# Pull Request

## Summary

Brief description of what this PR changes and why.

## Related Issue

Link to related issue (e.g., "Closes #42" or "Related to #15").

## Type of Change

- [ ] Protocol test change or addition
- [ ] Test result template update
- [ ] Documentation change
- [ ] CI workflow or tooling

## Accessibility Checklist for Doc Changes

For changes to Markdown documentation, please verify:

- [ ] Each file has exactly one H1 heading at the top
- [ ] No skipped heading levels (H1, H2, H3 in order)
- [ ] Tables have header rows and no merged cells
- [ ] Every image has meaningful alt text
- [ ] All links have descriptive text (no "click here" or bare URLs)
- [ ] No information is conveyed by color alone
- [ ] No em dashes or en dashes; only commas, colons, periods, or hyphens
- [ ] Plain language with short sentences
- [ ] Markdown passes markdownlint locally

## Vendor Neutrality

- [ ] This change does not name, rate, or compare any product or vendor
- [ ] If results are mentioned, they describe test data only, not endorsements

## Commit Hygiene

- [ ] Commit messages are plain text with no "Co-Authored-By" trailers
- [ ] Git hook is enabled (`git config core.hooksPath .githooks`)

## Additional Notes

Any additional context or testing notes.
